title: UFOs over nuclear bases every night of Travis Walton's disappearance
place_text: Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot, Malmstrom AFBs, United States

tellings.quote: And one of the stories people don't know that Travis was taken on November the 5th to the 10th. Every night that Travis was gone, there was a UFO over a nuclear missile or a nuclear weapon storage area in the United States.

plain: Every night that Travis Walton was missing, from November 5 to 10, 1975, a UFO appeared over a nuclear missile site or nuclear weapons storage area in the United States, according to the UFO researcher Grant Cameron. Walton is a man who said he was taken by a UFO in those days, and the bases named are Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot and Malmstrom Air Force bases. Cameron calls it a story people don't know, and tells it without naming a source, as a sign the abduction and the base sightings may be linked.
